jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Cosuno Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in. Your mission As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar. What you will achieve in your first year You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract. You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies. Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview. You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers. You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win. You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire. jobs.title: HR Stagiair
jobs.description: Ben jij een HR-student die niet alleen wil meekijken, maar echt wil meewerken? Bij Quatra krijg je geen stage met alleen opdrachten en meekijken vanaf de zijlijn. Je draait mee in het team, krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe HR er in de praktijk aan toegaat. Wat ga je doen Als HR-stagiair bij Quatra werk je mee aan alles wat met mensen te maken heeft. Praktisch, operationeel en dichtbij de business. Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar schakelt veel met collega’s en ziet direct wat jouw werk oplevert. Je komt terecht in een klein en betrokken HR-team. We werken informeel, helpen elkaar en zeggen waar het op staat. Geen hiërarchiegedoe, wel korte lijnen. Bij Quatra werken we volgens onze kernwaarden: Connect, Commit, Create. Dat merk je in hoe we samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ondersteunen bij werving en selectie, onboarding en offboarding; Opstellen van arbeidsovereenkomsten en verwerken van personeelsmutaties; Bijhouden van tijd-, verlof- en verzuimadministratie; Meewerken aan lopende HR-projecten en verbeteringen in onze processen; Uitvoeren van je stageopdrachten, afgestemd op jouw opleiding en leerdoelen. Wat breng jij mee? Je volgt een HRM-opleiding (HBO of MBO) of een vergelijkbare opleiding; Je bent enthousiast, gedreven en digitaal handig; Je wilt leren door te doen en durft vragen te stellen; Je werkt zorgvuldig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid; Je communiceert duidelijk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar (stageduur ± 4 maanden). Waarom stage lopen bij Quatra? Een meewerkstage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het team; Veel verantwoordelijkheid en hands-on ervaring binnen een snelgroeiende en duurzame organisatie. Een informele, directe en betrokken werksfeer waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn. Goede stagevergoeding en de kans om echt impact te maken. Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching om jouw HR-skills naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Over

Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients. About the Position We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR Business Partner to support employees, managers, and business leaders across multiple locations throughout the United States and Canada. This role combines hands-on HR support with business partnership, manager enablement, performance management, leadership development, leave administration, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate possesses strong HR expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective relationships while providing practical guidance and supporting organizational objectives. What You Do Daily Manager Enablement & Leadership Development Assist in the development and deliver manager training in collaboration with HR leadership to strengthen managerial skills and competencies. Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and support managers in the consistent application of HR policies and procedures. Leave Management & Employee Accommodations Manage and administer employee leaves of absence across the US and Canada, including FMLA, state and provincial leave programs, disability-related absences, and other app

jobs.title: People Operations Associate, 12 month fixed-term contract
jobs.description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ This role can be fully remote | £34,000 - £40,000 depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨ Our People Operations team⭐ We are looking for a People Operations Associate to join us for 12 months to provide caregiver cover. This is a fantastic opportunity to step into a high functioning team and keep our core operations running smoothly during a period of leave. Over the next 12 months we will be working on an HRIS implementation so we're looking for someone with hands on experience with HRIS design or systems migrations. Our team creates excellent employee experiences by designing and running reliable core people processes. We enable employees and managers by providing timely, accurate and user-friendly information and we own core People Systems making us the guardians of data accuracy and compliance. Each day will be different, and you'll learn a lot about the inner operations of how a People team works. The people lifecycle covers everything from the point someone is onboarded to offboarding and everything in between. jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever
